title: Robustness Gym: Unifying the NLP Evaluation Landscape
reasoning: The paper introduces a toolkit, Robustness Gym, designed to evaluate and benchmark NLP models. A core component and stated evaluation goal of this framework is 'detecting bias', with specific examples given such as gender bias. The case studies and user scenarios presented also focus on identifying and measuring biases in models. As detecting bias is a fundamental aspect of evaluating the ethical performance of AI systems, the paper provides a methodology for benchmarking a key component of AI ethics.
